source_review.notes: Checked current NASA Design Solution Definition, Logical Decomposition, Product Integration, Interface Management, and HSI planning guidance; the current SEBoK Physical Architecture article; official OMG SysML 2.0 metadata; and official ISO metadata for ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022 and 15288:2023. NASA, SEBoK, and OMG resources returned HTTP 200. ISO returned HTTP 403 to the command-line client, but the current official web representations had already been inspected through the web retrieval path. The chapter treats SEBoK as body-of-knowledge guidance and NASA/ISO/OMG applicability within their stated scopes rather than universalizing one process or notation.
